text: Visitors have reported confusion and frustration regarding the timed ticket system, with several noting a lack of clear information on-site and online about the need to order tickets in advance. Some found the location difficult to navigate, with directions leading to incorrect places. There were also complaints about limited customer service support, especially when trying to change tickets. While many praised the building’s architecture and interactive exhibits, some expressed disappointment that local North Dakota artists are not represented in the gift shop or exhibits, and criticized the use of AI-generated content.
